name: propera
description: View your finances and prepare income or expense proposals for review in Propera.

interface.longDescription: View your finances and prepare income or expense proposals for review in Propera.
defaultPrompt: Show me my current financial state.
Prepare an expense proposal for me to review.
Help me prepare an income movement for review.

positive.description: Read the connected account financial state
positive.prompt: Show me my current financial state.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated synthetic review account's financial summary with currentBalance, protectedAmount, savedAmount, and availableAmount only.

positive.prompt: Using the EUR reviewer account, prepare a 25 EUR expense proposal for a gym membership on August 30, 2026, with operation identifier review-expense-001.
positive.expected_behavior: Create or reuse a pending MCP proposal for the connected reviewer account and report its candidate ID and normalized details; do not resolve a financial movement.

positive.description: Prepare a synthetic income proposal with an explicit currency
positive.prompt: Using review@propera.life, prepare a 100 EUR income proposal for freelance work on September 1, 2026, with operation identifier review-income-001.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a pending 100 EUR income proposal with the supplied ISO currency and details, scoped to the connected review@propera.life synthetic account; do not resolve a financial movement.

positive.description: Explain the separate web confirmation step
positive.prompt: Using the EUR reviewer account, prepare a 25 EUR expense proposal for a gym membership, but do not register it; tell me what I need to do next.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a pending proposal and explain that definitive review and confirmation happen in the Propera web application; no financial movement is registered from ChatGPT.

positive.description: Retry an identical proposal without creating a duplicate
positive.prompt: Using the EUR reviewer account, repeat the exact expense proposal with identifier review-expense-001 and the same details.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the existing matching proposal or an equivalent idempotent result; no second candidate or financial effect is created.

negative.prompt: Register this pending proposal as a definitive financial movement directly from ChatGPT.
Connect to my bank and automatically categorize all my transactions.
Show me another person's financial state using their email address.

review.commerce_description: Propera no vende productos ni procesa pagos. Organiza información financiera personal y prepara propuestas de movimientos para revisión dentro del flujo autorizado.

publication.release_notes: Introducing Propera for ChatGPT. View your financial state and prepare income or expense proposals. Review and confirm your proposals securely in Propera.

es-ES.subtitle: Ordena tus finanzas
es-ES.description: Propera ayuda a organizar y entender las finanzas personales de tu cuenta conectada. Puede mostrar tu estado financiero y preparar propuestas estructuradas de ingresos o gastos que quedan pendientes para su revisión y confirmación explícita en la aplicación web de Propera. El registro definitivo de movimientos no está expuesto a través de ChatGPT. Propera no es un banco, no guarda dinero, no accede a tu banca online y no ejecuta transferencias. Solo accede a la información y acciones permitidas para la cuenta de Propera autenticada.
